subject.title: fix(codex): isolated cron reports Codex startup stalls

question: Is deterministic real-stdio initialize proof plus isolated-cron harness proof sufficient to merge this Codex initialize-timeout boundary fix without a reporter-account live OAuth recurring cron run?
rationale: The source and upstream protocol checks support the lifecycle boundary, but the production report proves the isolated cron setup timeout and idle worker rather than proving that the reporter-account stall was specifically inside client.initialize().

options.title: Accept lifecycle proof
options.body: Merge once exact-head checks are green, treating the deterministic initialize and isolated-cron proof as sufficient for this root-cause boundary.

options.title: Require live account proof
options.body: Hold merge until a representative OpenAI OAuth recurring cron/provider turn captures before/after behavior on a real account.
